name: Studio
author: skll
description: One home for desktop styling: Wallhaven and local wallpapers with transitions and auto-change, Hyprland animation presets, wallpaper-driven colors (Hyprskin: Material, wallbash and pywal-style schemes with contrast control and template exports) with per-part control over what follows them, the launcher with rofi-style layouts and color schemes (omalauncher), and the bar customizer.

barWidget.description: Launcher button, or the Studio popout, depending on the entry's role

schema.label: What this button does
schema.description: launcher: the Omarchy menu. studio: a popout from the bar with the wallpaper, its colors and the bar's contrast and effects, plus a button for the full Studio hub.
